none: PAS WMID-43CE58: Roman lead curse tablet
contea di ritrovamento: Staffordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A strip of lead, carefully folded up. There is a strong liklihood that this is a Roman curse tablet or votive and may contain an inscription on the inside asking for assistance from a deity. The length of the original strip of lead is difficult to determine as it has been folded over, but the tablet now measures 12.66 mm wide and 20.79 mm high. It is very worn and has a pale cream to brown patina
